items.title: Now on Google TV
items.text: Stremio Origin for Google TV and Android TV, on TVs and boxes from 2020 on: the same app, your accounts and settings, updates from inside the app.

items.title: Made for its remote
items.text: The D-pad, OK and Back do everything. Captions, Audio and Info keys go straight to their lists; Menu opens Settings, Search opens Search.

items.title: Sound and picture as made
items.text: On Google TV, Dolby Atmos, DTS and TrueHD go to your receiver as they are, and the screen follows the film's frame rate.
